blurb:
The majestic St. Lawrence River will offer you magnificent, unexpected scenery as well as several species of fish.

More than 200 species of fish found in the regions of Quebec, more than 150 species swim in the waters near Montreal. Among them, there are more than twenty sporting species such as walleye, bass, pike and sturgeon, among others.
